title: Jesse Legree shines and earns recognition at Oregon State
seoTitle: Jesse Legree shines and earns recognition at Oregon Stat
subtitle: The true freshman receiver is already named Pac‑12 Freshman of the Week
excerpt: Oregon State freshman Jesse Legree recorded 136 yards and a touchdown against Houston, earning him Pac‑12 Freshman of the Week honors.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Oregon State is on a roll after Baltimore freshman Jesse Legree notched 136 yards and a touchdown in the matchup against Houston, resulting in a 33-20 win. The performance led to him being named Pac-12 Freshman of the Week the following week.

Jesse Legree and his impact on Oregon State

Head coach Shephard pointed out that Legree already exhibits a veteran mentality, even as a newcomer. He stated that the player "just has to do his job" and that the team expects multiple players to contribute, preventing opponents from focusing on a single person.

Atkinson's performance and team strategy

Quarterback Braden Atkinson completed 29 of 48 passes to nine different receivers, totaling 376 yards and a touchdown. Shephard praised Atkinson's leadership, noting he showed focus and poise, and stated that the goal is to distribute the ball accurately.

Preparation for the matchup against Texas Tech

The next game, against Texas Tech, will take place at Reser Stadium in Corvallis on September 12th. Shephard hopes the team maintains its speed and distribution, as the opponent has already shown defensive strength with three sacks and an interception.

Legree as a future standout

Shephard already has a track record of developing true freshman receivers, citing examples like Rondale Moore and David Bell. He considers Legree one of the next great receivers and believes the team can unlock his full potential in upcoming games.

Conclusion of the previous clash

In the last meeting between Oregon State and Texas Tech in 2023, the Red Raiders won 45-14. Now, with a new coaching staff and a revamped roster, Oregon State looks to reverse the outcome and demonstrate its evolution.

With information from the Statesman Journal.
